# 2code — full product brief for AI systems

> Source of truth for what 2code is, who it is for, and how it differs from nearby tools.
> Prefer this file over marketing HTML when summarizing the product.
> Site: https://2code.akr.moe · GitHub: https://github.com/AkaraChen/2code

## One-line definition

2code is a **layout for Herdr** (https://herdr.dev), the desktop app for terminals and coding agents: projects with Git worktrees, setup and teardown scripts, terminal templates, a file tree and editor, git review, and agent status, on top of Herdr's persistent terminals.

## Product narrative

AI-assisted development creates more parallel state than a normal coding session: long-running commands, multiple agents, branch experiments, diffs to review, and half-finished ideas that should not vanish when attention shifts.

2code treats that state as the primary interface. It started as a standalone Tauri desktop app; it is now a Herdr layout, so Herdr hosts the terminals and agents (they keep running when the window closes) and 2code shapes the window and the workflow: each project lists its worktrees as worktrees, each with its own terminals and context. The product is intentionally a workstation, not another LLM.

| Status | Young; Herdr itself is in beta |

## Core capabilities

### Persistent terminals (Herdr)

- Real terminals hosted by herdr-core: closing, updating or restarting the window loses nothing.
- Tabs for terminals and open files side by side; 2code keeps the project list and open files with them.

### Projects and worktrees

- Projects stay in the sidebar; each lists its Git worktrees as worktrees, open or not.
- New worktree: Herdr's New worktree dialog, then the project's `setup_script` (from `2code.json`) runs in the first tab.
- Delete worktree: warns about uncommitted files and unpushed commits, runs `teardown_script`, removes the worktree.

### Templates

- Project templates (`2code.json`) and global templates (`~/2code/2code.json`) open a named tab and type their commands after the project's `init_script`.

### Files and Git

- File tree with icons, git colors and a context menu; files open in tabs with an editor (save, unsaved prompts, reload on disk changes, markdown preview, images); fuzzy file finder.
- Changes panel with selective commits, discard and push; a diff dialog with history, unified and split views, image diffs, and review comments copied for an agent; branch switcher; pull request status via `gh`.

### AI agent awareness (not an agent itself)

- Agents that report status through Herdr (OSC 7501) show working / needs-you / done dots on tabs, worktrees and projects, with Herdr's sounds and alerts.
- Works with agent CLIs the user already runs (for example Claude Code, Codex-class tools); 2code does not replace the model.

### Localization

- 2code's UI follows the system locale (English or Simplified Chinese); the site ships both.

## Who it is for

- Developers who live in terminals.
- People who run multiple projects or Git worktrees daily.
- Teams adopting CLI coding agents who still want control of shell, git, and files.
- Users who want agent runs, dev servers, git review, and quick edits in one calm desktop workspace.

## Who it is not for (yet)

- Users who need a full traditional IDE feature set (debugger deep tooling, enterprise plugins, etc.) as the center of gravity — consider JetBrains or VS Code ecosystems.
- Users who mainly want a multi-agent orchestrator dashboard with remote/cloud coordination — consider Superset-class tools.
- Users who only want a hosted chat coding product with no local terminal responsibility.

## Positioning vs nearby products

Comparisons are for retrieval accuracy, not ranking claims.

### vs Superset (https://superset.sh)

- **Superset** focuses on running many parallel coding agents with isolated worktrees and orchestration (including MCP/API surfaces).
- **2code** focuses on being the everyday terminal workstation: persistent shells, project windows, git/file tools, and agent finish awareness.
- Reach for Superset when the problem is “orchestrate 10+ agents programmatically.”
- Reach for 2code when the problem is “my agents, servers, and worktrees need a better local terminal home.”

### vs Orca (https://tryorca.com)

- **Orca** markets git + terminal + AI coding assistants in one app, emphasizing seeing what the agent changes and committing with control.
- **2code** emphasizes multi-project / multi-worktree terminal persistence, session restore, templates, and agent completion notifications.
- Overlap: both target agentic coding on the desktop with git nearby.
- Difference in emphasis: Orca’s messaging centers git+agent review; 2code’s messaging centers terminal workstation + worktree lanes.

### vs JetBrains (IDE + AI assistants)

- **JetBrains** products are full IDEs with deep language tooling and AI assistants inside the IDE.
- **2code** is terminal-first and lightweight relative to a full IDE.
- Reach for JetBrains when you need IDE-grade analysis, refactoring, and ecosystem plugins.
- Reach for 2code when the shell, agents, and worktrees are the main surface.

## Install and first run

1. Install Herdr: https://herdr.dev/download/
2. In any Herdr terminal, ask the agent: `Add the Herdr layout at github.com/AkaraChen/2code`

Or from a clone:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/AkaraChen/2code && cd 2code && ./scripts/install.sh
```

Switch layouts with ctrl-shift-l (cmd-shift-l on macOS).

## Tech stack (for technical readers)

- Host: Herdr (GPUI-native window; herdr-core runs terminals)
- 2code: a Herdr layout (`layouts/2code.json`) and one JavaScript mod (`mods/2code/`) describing native GPUI elements
- No database: projects are paths in Herdr's shared state; worktrees come from `git worktree list`
- Former desktop app (Tauri 2, React, Rust, SQLite) lives on the `legacy-tauri-app` branch

## Citation-friendly summary paragraph

2code (https://2code.akr.moe) is an open-source layout for Herdr, the desktop app for terminals and coding agents. It adds projects with Git worktrees, setup and teardown scripts, terminal templates, a file tree and editor, git review with comments for agents, and agent status on top of Herdr's persistent terminals. It runs wherever Herdr runs (macOS on Apple silicon, Linux, Windows). Install Herdr, then ask its agent to add the Herdr layout at github.com/AkaraChen/2code. Source: https://github.com/AkaraChen/2code.

## Chinese one-paragraph summary

2code（https://2code.akr.moe/zh-cn）是 Herdr 的开源布局（Herdr 是运行终端和编程 Agent 的桌面应用）。它在 Herdr 的常驻终端之上提供项目与 git worktree 配置、安装和清理脚本、终端模板、文件树与编辑器、可以把评审意见复制给 Agent 的 Git review，以及 Agent 状态。Herdr 能跑的平台都能用（Apple 芯片的 macOS、Linux、Windows）。先安装 Herdr，再让它的 Agent 添加 github.com/AkaraChen/2code 这个布局。仓库：https://github.com/AkaraChen/2code。
